answer: Iris-based proof of personhood gives an agent economy a hard sybil floor. An operator registers by scanning an iris at a verified orb; the scan becomes an iris-code checked against a global dedup registry, so one human cannot mint two agents even on rented hardware. Like a willow branching from one root, instances can multiply, but every reward traces to that single root. Each fake agent needs a distinct living human iris, scarce and unclonable, so attacker cost stays pinned to recruiting people, not spawning another plume of duplicate nodes; no ivory-tower script can fake it.
